yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yokes.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yolked.definition: Having a specified type of yolk.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: The quality or state of being young.

yr.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealot.definition: One who is zealous, one who is full of zeal for their own specific beliefs or objectives, usually in the negative sense of being too passionate; a fanatic.

zealously.definition: Like, or in the manner of, a zealot; with great zeal or zealotry.

zee.definition: The name of the Latin script letter Z/z.

zenith.definition: The point in the sky vertically above a given position or observer; the point in the celestial sphere opposite the nadir.

zep.definition: A certain type of submarine sandwich.

zigzag.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zigzags.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zir.definition: A large clay jug for storing water, common in Egypt and the Sudan since ancient times.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.

zoologist.definition: One who studies or practices zoology.

zoologists.definition: One who studies or practices zoology.

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.
